source.primaryEdition: Library of Congress Derge edition W4CZ5369
source.fallbackEdition: Karmapa/Parphud edition W22084 for missing or unreadable passages
source.derivedFrom: UVA-SOAS 2013 eKangyur with BDRC OCR, ACIP and Adarsha comparisons; further proofread by Esukhia-Barom

rights.statement: This work is a mechanical reproduction of a Public Domain work, and as such is also in the Public Domain.

definition.workUnit: distinct BDRC linked abstract work identifier, retained as a catalog-authority candidate
definition.inclusionRule: All 1,122 BDRC top-level D identifiers found in Esukhia volumes 001–102, including eight entries absent or unlocated in the Parphud outline but present in the LOC-oriented Esukhia text.
definition.exclusionRule: Volume 103 and 76 nested component markers are preserved as reference or structure but excluded from top-level scripture-expression counts.
definition.denominatorCaveat: 1,122 is complete for this fixed digital Derge witness, not the global number of Buddhist works; 851 linked BDRC work identifiers are not a cross-tradition deduplicated global denominator.
definition.attributionCaveat: Canonical inclusion does not establish that every item is the Buddha's verbatim speech.

anomalies.sourcePagePolicy: Duplicate, skipped and x-marked page numbers are preserved; repeated page-line anchors receive a deterministic two-digit occurrence suffix in stable segment IDs.
anomalies.componentCountDecision: The five-item difference and identifier sets remain published as evidence; no silent equivalence is asserted.
